summary: Lloyds Banking Group filed a Form 6-K reporting its purchase of 20,000,000 ordinary shares on May 6, 2026, at a volume-weighted average price of 99.2954 pence per share, under an existing buyback program announced January 30, 2026. The shares were bought from Goldman Sachs International and will be cancelled, reducing the share count. This is an ordinary-course capital return without structural features or premium. The filing equates to a US issuer's share repurchase disclosure. Watch for continued execution of the buyback program; no risk-arb angle as this is an open-market return of capital.
